svg.title: Cerebrolysin's key randomized trials: the biggest one was neutral
svg.desc: Cerebrolysin's key randomized trials: the biggest one was neutral. CASTA 2012, acute stroke, 1070 people: Main goal: no difference. CEREHETIS 2023, stroke (open-label), 341 people: Fewer bleeds; no 90-day difference. CAPTAIN II 2020, brain injury, 142 people: Small-to-medium combined benefit. ESCAS 2025, post-stroke aphasia, 132 people: Better language scores. Iran 2017, early stroke recovery, 100 people: Better day-30 stroke scores. Korea 2000, Alzheimer's disease, 53 people: Better at 4 weeks; daily life same. Healthy men 1998, EEG study, 48 people: EEG changes; memory only a trend. CAPTAIN I 2020, brain injury, 46 people: Main goal just missed.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
